newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers unchanged, other ports catch up.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers unchanged, other ports catch up.

text.p: ARA bunker prices barely responded to barge market gains, while the rest of Europe mostly firmed after Wednesday's market rebound, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST traded at around $102/$104 fob as on Wednesday, despite a moderate rise in the barge price. A couple of reasonable sized enquiries emerged, but little else of sustenance for suppliers.
Total ARA volume was around 10,000 tonnes, dealers said.
Hamburg bunker bids and offers were wide apart. Buyers were unwilling to raise their bids, but offers rose by around $2 to $112. Trading was slack.
Mediterranean bunkers were mostly firm in response to Wednesday's gains elsewhere. Demand was average, although reasonably healthy around Gibraltar.
Fujairah prices nudged reached $100 as Singapore picked up almost $10 a tonne.
